I.value_zh: 现有 FCoP 0.7.2 语境、docs/tutorials 目录、中文教程主文件、教程 README、规则与 ADR 的相对链接目标。
I.value_en: The stated FCoP 0.7.2 context, docs/tutorials directory, Chinese tutorial main file, tutorial README, and relative-link targets for rules and ADRs.
I.notes_zh: 不读取新机器 dogfood、真实截图或外部协议正文。
I.notes_en: No new-machine dogfood, real screenshots, or external protocol text is read.

O.value_zh: 中文教程骨架文件和教程目录 README，包含列明章节、可复制 prompt、工具调用清单、截图占位符、解说、FAQ、相对链接以及未来教程占位。
O.value_en: A Chinese tutorial skeleton and tutorial-directory README containing the named chapters, copyable prompts, tool-call lists, screenshot placeholders, explanations, FAQ, relative links, and a future-tutorial placeholder.
O.notes_zh: 不把真实截图、英文版或视频列为本次输出。
O.notes_en: Real screenshots, English version, and video are not outputs of this task.

A.value_zh: 创建或改写两个教程文件，按四章骨架编写内容和每章必含元素，保留截图占位符，写 done report 并 archive task。
A.value_en: Create or rewrite two tutorial files, write content and required elements for the four-chapter outline, retain screenshot placeholders, write a done report, and archive the task.
A.notes_zh: 无代码变更或发版动作。
A.notes_en: There is no code-change or release action.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 是任务发起主体，ME 是任务接收主体；未来英文 session 的执行者不是本任务当前主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is the task originator and ME is the recipient; the future English-session actor is not a current task participant.
P.notes_zh: 不从角色名称推导权限。
P.notes_en: No authority is inferred from role names.

R.value_zh: 教程长度须至少 800 字且不超过 2500 字。
R.value_en: The tutorial must be at least 800 and at most 2500 Chinese words/characters as stated.
R.notes_zh: 未补造其他时间、预算或容量限制。
R.notes_en: No other time, budget, or capacity limit is fabricated.

V.value_zh: FCoP 0.7.2、Rule 0.a.1、Rule 1、Rule 5、ADR-0002、ADR-0006，以及 README 对英文版状态的说明。
V.value_en: FCoP 0.7.2, Rules 0.a.1, 1, and 5, ADR-0002, ADR-0006, and the README statement about English-version status.
V.notes_zh: 只保留引用，不验证正文。
V.notes_en: References are retained without verifying their contents.

C.value_zh: 两个文件落盘并通过 markdownlint（如已配置）；教程在 800–2500 字范围；prompt 可复制且无中文全角符号干扰；条款引用均为列明相对路径；README 含本教程和未来教程占位。
C.value_en: Both files are present and pass markdownlint if configured; the tutorial is within 800–2500; prompts are copyable without full-width Chinese punctuation interference; rule references use the stated relative paths; README contains this tutorial and a future-tutorial placeholder.
C.notes_zh: “如果配置”是条件化 lint 检查，不补造 lint 配置。
C.notes_en: “If configured” is a conditional lint check; no lint configuration is fabricated.

B.value_zh: 不得加入真实截图、英文版、视频/GIF；不得因文档新增触发发版。
B.value_en: Do not add real screenshots, English version, or video/GIF; do not trigger a release for this documentation addition.
B.notes_zh: 不加入未给出的主机策略。
B.notes_en: No unprovided host policy is added.
